title: NVIDEA Personal AI — judge demo package

beats.label: Invoke anywhere on Windows with bounded desktop context
beats.judgeClaim: Show global invocation and active-app/selection context without silently sending clipboard content.
beats.fallbackPolicy: Fail the take if invocation, bounded context, or Nemotron completion evidence is unavailable; do not substitute terminal output.

evidence.claim: Deterministic evaluator verifies context inclusion and clipboard withholding.
Voice invocation is local, consented, cancellable, and review-first.

beats.label: Durable personal memory changes the later answer
beats.judgeClaim: Show a remembered preference/project fact influencing a later invocation while preserving sensitivity controls.
preflightDependencies: A safe demo memory is present
beats.fallbackPolicy: Fail the take if memory influence is not visible and evidenced; never inject or reveal sensitive memory to rescue the demo.

evidence.claim: Cross-cutting evaluator verifies durable memory recall.
Local semantic embeddings preserve provider/model provenance and privacy boundaries.

beats.label: Tavily research with visible sources and citation validation
beats.judgeClaim: Show multi-source research, provenance, explicit uncertainty, and citations that map back to collected evidence.
beats.fallbackPolicy: Fail the live Tavily claim if validated citation evidence is absent; synthetic evaluator output may be shown only as synthetic engineering evidence.

evidence.claim: Synthetic evaluator proves citation plumbing and research-engine invariants, not live Tavily availability.
Adversarial evaluator rejects invented citation identifiers.

beats.label: Complex browser task uses act-observe-verify rather than blind clicks
beats.judgeClaim: Show a multi-step browser action and visible post-action verification; failed verification must halt the plan.
beats.fallbackPolicy: Fail the take if trusted post-action verification is absent; never bypass login, CAPTCHA, MFA, site safeguards, or manually complete the action.

evidence.claim: Negative evaluator proves verification failure stops the plan.
Browser integration harness documents live browser validation boundaries.

beats.label: Consequential action pauses for explicit approval
beats.judgeClaim: Show send/submit-style authority remaining locked until an exact-scope user approval is granted.
preflightDependencies: Consequential demo action reaches trusted approval boundary
beats.fallbackPolicy: Fail the take if the exact-scope approval UI does not appear; never pre-authorize, auto-approve, or manually bypass the gate.

evidence.claim: Positive evaluator verifies consequential browser approval.
Denied/wrong-scope approval cannot mutate state; prompt injection cannot self-authorize.

beats.label: Long-running research has an explicit Nebius Serverless contract
beats.judgeClaim: Show resumable long-running work and the redacted Nebius deployment/evidence contract. Claim live provider execution only when matching live evidence has actually been generated and verified.
preflightDependencies: Live provider credentials are configured only when claiming provider-live execution
beats.fallbackPolicy: If authenticated audited remote-result evidence is absent, describe the contract only; never relabel captured, synthetic, dispatched-only, or stale evidence as live execution.

evidence.claim: Documents zero-cost preflight and explicit paid live contract execution.
Defines the redacted deployment fingerprint and live PASS evidence boundary.
Defines zero-inference model-catalog readiness evidence and captured-vs-live semantics.
Unified verifier rejects captured or stale catalog evidence as current provider readiness.

beats.label: Close on the architecture and evidence boundary
beats.judgeClaim: Show that Nemotron/Nebius/Tavily are architectural dependencies, private OS actions stay local, and synthetic evidence is never presented as live provider proof.
beats.fallbackPolicy: Do not overclaim missing session/provider evidence; close on the architecture and explicitly typed evidence that is actually available.

evidence.claim: Judge-facing evidence-class separation, freshness gate, and non-claims.

commands.label: Fresh live Nebius model catalog readiness
Unified judging evidence verifier
commands.command: dotnet run --project tools/Nvidea.JudgingEvidenceVerifier/Nvidea.JudgingEvidenceVerifier.csproj -- artifacts/personal-ai-positive.json artifacts/personal-ai-adversarial.json artifacts/nebius-manifest.json artifacts/nebius-pass.json artifacts/nebius-model-catalog-live.json --output artifacts/judging-summary.json
